description: The largest tractable block. Release correlations (the boon-lay TRISO Booth/breakthrough/attenuation models are genuinely VERIFIED, not merely tested -- reuse them), the 17-class RN structure, then port AeroSolved's (GPL-3.0) sectional method onto lumped control volumes rather than resolved fields. Verify against PartMC (GPL-2.0-or-later) used as a particle-resolved REFERENCE model, not as the production path. Pool scrubbing (SPARC-90) and iodine chemistry have no open code and must come from literature; PHREEQC is the natural aqueous-iodine engine. Check every licence byte-for-byte before porting.

description:
tampines::gas_phase landed 2026-08-11 (op-jyyp.12) with three working component models -- GasDuct (Churchill friction + Gnielinski/Dittus-Boelter heat transfer, low-Mach compressible), KtaBed (KTA 3102.3 packed-bed pressure drop) and Circulator (idealised fixed-rise/fixed-ratio compression). They are deliberately NOT wired into src/components/, which bead op-ql8 owns.

Interface notes for whoever does that wiring:

1. PipeBackend (components/pipe.rs) is an enum over stateful fluid ARRAYS (SinglePhaseFluidArray, CompressibleFluidArray, TampinesSteamArray, InsulatedFluidComponent). gas_phase::GasDuct is a different shape: it is stateless plain-data geometry plus a one-shot steady solve(mass_flow, T_in, p_in, boundary) -> GasDuctResult. It is NOT a drop-in PipeBackend variant.
   Suggested resolution: add a separate `SteadyGas(GasDuct)` variant, and accept that Pipe's methods split into a transient path (the array backends) and a steady path (this one), rather than forcing GasDuct to carry cell state it does not have.

2. KtaBed has no components/ counterpart at all -- a porous/packed-bed component struct would be new. It composes cleanly with crate::pebble_bed::zbs::ZbsBed (friction side + conduction side of the same bed).

3. Circulator is the gas analogue of components::Pump. Pump is currently a NotYetImplemented wrapper, so the cleanest move is probably a `PumpBackend` enum with a `GasCirculator(Circulator)` variant, mirroring PipeBackend.

4. All three take/return uom types and use crate::TampinesError, so error and unit conventions already match components/.

5. gas_phase exposes two public uom aliases -- MassFlux (kg/(m^2 s)) and PressureGradient (Pa/m) -- because uom ships no named types for those dimensions. If components/ needs them, re-export rather than redefining; note outram-park-digital-twin-engine/src/htr10/kta.rs independently defines identical aliases.

Blocked on op-ql8 finishing the NotYetImplemented wrapper pass.
title: tampines components/: add gas-phase variants so gas_phase components slot into the Pipe/Pump component layer

description:
Follow-up from op-jyyp.16 (ZBS test suite written 2026-08-11).

Two items in crates/tampines/src/pebble_bed/zbs.rs need a HUMAN with sources in hand; neither can be closed by running code:

1. TRANSCRIPTION. The dimensionless ZBS form (B, k_r, N, k_c, k_eff/k_f) was implemented without page-level access to the printed originals. The new test suite verifies the k_r -> 0 degeneration to the classic Zehner-Schlunder closed form to 1.398e-16 relative, but that is an ALGEBRAIC cross-check of the same expression regrouped -- it cannot detect a transcription error in the source equations. Needs checking against van Antwerpen, du Toit & Rousseau, Nucl. Eng. Des. 240 (2010) 1803-1818, eqs (12)-(16) (proprietary tier). Until then the module stays at Prototype in the V&V pipeline.

2. UNCITED CLAIM. The module docs previously asserted that stagnant-helium graphite beds measure order 1-2 W/(m K) at ambient in SANA/HTTU-class experiments, used as support for the finding that the VTB 18-point table is not reproducible. On 2026-08-11 this was flagged in-file as an uncited recollection, NOT checked against any source. It must be either given a real citation (source, tier, URL/DOI, date accessed per DATA_POLICY.md) or removed. None of the measured numbers in the module depend on it.

Also note the near-wall profile coefficients (1.36, 5.0) in ZbsBed::wall_region_porosity carry the same unverified-coefficient caveat.

Context: the VTB table mismatch itself is already tracked as op-jvua. Measured 2026-08-11: model/table ratio 0.176932 at 300 K rising to 0.644374 at 2000 K; reproducing the 300 K point would need k_f = 3.8367 W/(m K), 23.99x helium at 300 K / 6 MPa.
title: tampines zbs: human transcription check vs van Antwerpen (2010) eqs (12)-(16), and cite-or-drop the SANA/HTTU claim
